case_title: M/S. KALAMANI TEX & ANR v. P. BALASUBRAMANIAN
neutral_facts: The case involves a financial dispute where the accused, through their legal representative, were directed by the court to transfer a sum of money to the respondent. The amount was found to be in a non-interest earning account, leading to a modification in the court's directive to remove the mention of interest. The case primarily revolves around the transfer of funds and the correction of a directive based on the account details.
